---
id: move
label: Move Mishaps
source: User-provided excerpt of the Move (Agility) skill from Forbidden Lands; table assumes jumping, climbing, rapid movement, ducking in close combat, and fleeing conflict
dice: D66
version: 1
---

## Rows

| dice | result | effect | severity | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 11-13 | Slipped Footing | Your footing gives way at the last second. You lose momentum and fail to reach the intended position cleanly. | Low |  |
| 14-16 | Hard Landing | You make the jump or scramble badly and hit the ground awkwardly. Suffer 1 point of damage to Agility. | Moderate |  |
| 21-23 | Lost Grip | Your hand slips on stone, rope, or ledge. You hang in a bad position and must recover fast or fall. | Moderate |  |
| 24-26 | Twisted Knee | You pivot, duck, or sprint at the wrong angle and wrench your leg. Suffer 1 point of damage to Agility. | Moderate |  |
| 31-33 | Collision | You crash into terrain, furniture, or another person while moving at speed. Both position and timing are ruined. | Moderate |  |
| 34-36 | Exposed Dodge | You avoid the first threat but leave yourself open to the next. An enemy gains an immediate opening against you. | High |  |
| 41-43 | Fall | You lose balance from a height, ladder, cart, or wall and fall hard. Suffer an attack with four Base Dice. | High |  |
| 44-46 | Cornered Escape | Your attempt to flee or reposition sends you into a dead end, hazard, or tighter press of enemies. | High |  |
| 51-53 | Dropped Gear | Something important flies loose while you run, climb, or leap. The GM decides what was dropped and where it lands. | Moderate |  |
| 54-56 | Breath Gone | The sprint or scramble empties your lungs and wrecks your pace. Suffer 1 point of damage to Strength from overexertion. | High |  |
| 61-63 | Trampled or Pinned | You go down in a dangerous spot and are pinned under weight, bodies, or debris until freed. | Severe |  |
| 64-66 | Fatal Misstep | Your movement fails completely at the worst possible moment, placing you in the path of a deadly fall, strike, or capture. | Catastrophic |  |
